# Verify all requirements are met before finishing
import subprocess

# 1. Check exactly 3 commits on top of base
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
commits = result.stdout.strip().split('\n')
print(f"Number of commits: {len(commits)}")
for c in commits:
    print(f"  {c}")

# 2. Check tests pass
result2 = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider',
     'tests/test_filesize.py', 'tests/test_i18n.py', 'tests/test_lists.py',
     'tests/test_number.py', 'tests/test_time.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(f"\nTests: {'PASSED' if result2.returncode == 0 else 'FAILED'}")
last_line = [l for l in result2.stdout.split('\n') if 'passed' in l.lower()]
if last_line:
    print(last_line[-1])

# 3. Verify no test files were modified
result3 = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
modified = result3.stdout.strip().split('\n')
print(f"\nModified files:")
for f in modified:
    print(f"  {f}")
test_files_modified = any('test' in f or 'conftest' in f for f in modified)
print(f"Test files modified: {test_files_modified}")
